use_cases: Displaying user profile pictures in navigation headers or user menus
Showing user avatars in comment sections or social feeds
Representing users in contact lists or team member directories
Fallback display when user hasn't uploaded a profile image
Avatar display in card components showing user information
ai_summary: A minimalist avatar component built with Radix UI primitives featuring image and fallback states. Supports custom styling through Tailwind classes with rounded-full design. Uses semantic HTML with proper accessibility attributes from Radix. Suitable for any application needing user profile picture display with graceful degradation to initials.
